ONE FAMILY. TWO CONNECTED OPERATIONS.

It starts on the land.
It reaches your market.

Good supply begins with understanding where it comes from. Bigfoot Australia owns farms and raises livestock, including sheep and goats. Bigfoot Meats connects that farming story with wholesale meat supply and trade in Singapore.

Together, we bring the source and the market into the same conversation—whether you’re sourcing meat, exploring an export opportunity, or planning a supply partnership.
